title: Moroccan Chicken Tagine
description: A traditional North African stew made with chicken, spices, and dried fruits. This dish is typically cooked in a clay pot called a tagine.

ingredients.name: Moroccan spice mix
ingredients.notes: available at most spice stores or online

instructions: Heat oil in the bottom of a clay tagine or a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the chicken legs and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the Moroccan spice mix, pitted olives, chopped apricots, and chicken broth.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the tagine and transfer it to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 30-40 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
If using honey, stir it in during the last 10 minutes of cooking.
Serve the chicken and sauce over couscous or rice.
